A través de este libro, explorará conceptos como gobernanza de datos, prácticas de seguridad y optimización de rendimiento para ayudarle a convertirse en un arquitecto de datos de Salesforce adepto.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender y aplicar la arquitectura de datos de Salesforce a proyectos del mundo real.
Cree estrategias robustas para la copia de seguridad de datos y el archivo en Salesforce.
Leverage Salesforce Customer 360 para mejorar la gestión de las relaciones con los clientes.
Armonizar estrategias de gestión de datos maestros con objetivos organizativos utilizando Salesforce.
Optimize Salesforce for GDPR compliance and large data volume (LDV) handling.

Autor(s)

Ninguno Zafar es un experimentado consultor de Salesforce y autor con antecedentes para diseñar e implementar soluciones de Salesforce a nivel empresarial. Zafar es apasionado por empoderar a otros con el conocimiento para optimizar sus implementaciones de Salesforce para la gestión y seguridad de datos. Sobresalen al transmitir conceptos técnicos avanzados de manera accesible y práctica.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es para administradores de Salesforce, desarrolladores y aspirantes a arquitectos que ya tienen una comprensión fundamental de Salesforce. Es ideal para personas que buscan avanzar en sus carreras dominando la arquitectura y gestión de datos de Salesforce. Tanto si se está preparando para la certificación Salesforce Data Architecture and Management como para mejorar las prácticas organizativas de datos, este libro proporciona valiosas ideas adaptadas a sus necesidades.

title: Critical Thinking Strategies for Success (Collection)
description:
3 great books help you think more clearly about any problem – and transform better thinking into better results – in business, and in life!

Three remarkable books help you think more clearly, flexibly, effectively — and transform better thinking into better personal and business performance! Critical Thinking: Tools for Taking Charge of Your Professional and Personal Life offers practical tools for becoming a better thinker in every aspect of your life: in your career, and as a consumer, citizen, friend, parent, and lover. Richard W. Paul and Linda Elder reveal the core skills of effective thinking, helping you analyze your own thought processes, identify weaknesses, and overcome them. The Truth About Making Smart Decisions brings together 50 powerful “truths” about making better decisions: real solutions for the tough challenges faced by every decision-maker, in business and in life. You'll discover how to systematically prepare to make better decisions...how to get the right information, without getting buried in useless data...how to minimize your risks, and then act decisively...how to make better group decisions...profit from mistakes...and a whole lot more. Finally, Now You're Thinking!: Change Your Thinking...Transform Your Life draws on an incredible story of survival in wartime to introduce a model of critical thinking that will help you recognize how your emotions are shaping your actions, evaluate arguments more effectively, and draw conclusions that lead you directly to better life decisions.

From world-renowned leaders in the promotion of effective thinking, includingDr. Richard Paul, Dr. Linda Elder, Robert E. Gunther,Judy Chartrand, Stewart Emery, Russ Hall, Heather Ishikawa, and John Maketa
translatedDescription:
3 grandes libros le ayudan a pensar más claramente sobre cualquier problema – y transformar mejor el pensamiento en mejores resultados – en negocios, y en la vida!

¡Tres libros notables le ayudan a pensar con mayor claridad, flexibilidad y eficacia y a transformar mejor el pensamiento en un mejor desempeño personal y empresarial! Pensamiento crítico: Herramientas para tomar carga de su vida profesional y personal ofrece herramientas prácticas para convertirse en un mejor pensador en cada aspecto de su vida: en su carrera, y como consumidor, ciudadano, amigo, padre y amante. Richard W. Paul y Linda Elder revelan las habilidades básicas del pensamiento eficaz, ayudando a analizar sus propios procesos de pensamiento, identificar debilidades y superarlos. La verdad sobre la toma de decisiones inteligentes reúne 50 poderosas “verdades” sobre la toma de mejores decisiones: soluciones reales para los duros desafíos que enfrenta cada toma de decisiones, en el negocio y en la vida. Usted descubrirá cómo prepararse sistemáticamente para tomar mejores decisiones... cómo obtener la información correcta, sin ser enterrado en datos inútiles... cómo minimizar sus riesgos, y luego actuar con decisión... cómo tomar mejores decisiones de grupo... lucrativa de errores... y mucho más. Finalmente, ¡Ahora estás pensando!: Cambia tu pensamiento... Transforma tu vida aprovecha una increíble historia de supervivencia en tiempos de guerra para introducir un modelo de pensamiento crítico que te ayude a reconocer cómo tus emociones están modelando tus acciones, evaluar los argumentos más eficazmente y sacar conclusiones que te llevan directamente a mejores decisiones de vida.

De líderes de renombre mundial en la promoción del pensamiento efectivo, incluyendo al Dr. Richard Paul, Dr. Linda Elder, Robert E. Gunther,Judy Chartrand, Stewart Emery, Russ Hall, Heather Ishikawa, y John Maketa

title: Dashboards for Excel
description:
The book takes a hands-on approach to developing dashboards, from instructing users on advanced Excel techniques to addressing dashboard pitfalls common in the real world. Dashboards for Excel is your key to creating informative, actionable, and interactive dashboards and decision support systems. Throughout the book, the reader is challenged to think about Excel and data analytics differently—that is, to think outside the cell. This book shows you how to create dashboards in Excel quickly and effectively.

In this book, you learn how to:

Apply data visualization principles for more effective dashboards
Employ dynamic charts and tables to create dashboards that are constantly up-to-date and providing fresh information
Use understated yet powerful formulas for Excel development
Apply advanced Excel techniques mixing formulas and Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) to create interactive dashboards
Create dynamic systems for decision support in your organization
Avoid common problems in Excel development and dashboard creation
Get started with the Excel data model, PowerPivot, and Power Query
translatedDescription:
El libro toma un enfoque práctico para el desarrollo de tableros de mando, desde la instrucción de los usuarios en técnicas avanzadas de Excel para abordar los obstáculos de tablero común en el mundo real. Dashboards for Excel es su clave para crear paneles informativos, accionables e interactivos y sistemas de soporte de decisiones. A lo largo del libro, el lector es desafiado a pensar en Excel y análisis de datos de manera diferente, es decir, pensar fuera de la célula. En este libro aprendes a:

Aplicar principios de visualización de datos para tableros de datos más eficaces

Crear sistemas dinámicos de apoyo a decisiones en su organización
Evite problemas comunes en el desarrollo de Excel y la creación de tableros de control
Comenzar con el modelo de datos Excel, PowerPivot y Power Query

title: Writing and Editing for Digital Media, 5th Edition
description: In this fifth edition, Brian Carroll explores writing and editing for digital media with essential information about voice, style, media formats, ideation, story planning, and storytelling.
translatedDescription: En esta quinta edición, Brian Carroll explora la escritura y edición de medios digitales con información esencial sobre voz, estilo, formatos multimedia, ideación, planificación de historias y narración.

title: Decision Quality
description:
Add value with every decision using a simple yet powerful framework

Few things are as valuable in business, and in life, as the ability to make good decisions. Can you imagine how much more rewarding your life and your business would be if every decision you made were the best it could be? Decision Quality empowers you to make the best possible choice and get more of what you truly want from every decision.

Dr. Carl Spetzler is a leader in the field of decision science and has worked with organizations across industries to improve their decision-making capabilities. He and his co-authors, all experienced consultants and educators in this field, show you how to frame a problem or opportunity, create a set of attractive alternatives, identify relevant uncertain information, clarify the values that are important in the decision, apply tools of analysis, and develop buy-in among stakeholders. Their straightforward approach is elegantly simple, yet practical and powerful. It can be applied to all types of decisions.

Our business and our personal lives are marked by a stream of decisions. Some are small. Some are large. Some are life-altering or strategic. How well we make those decisions truly matters. This book gives you a framework and thinking tools that will help you to improve the odds of getting more of what you value from every choice. You will learn:

The six requirements for decision quality, and how to apply them
The difference between a good decision and a good outcome
Why a decision can only be as good as the best of the available alternatives
Methods for making both "significant" and strategic decisions
The mental traps that undermine decision quality and how to avoid them
How to deal with uncertainty—a factor in every important choice
How to judge the quality of a decision at the time you're making it
How organizations have benefited from building quality into their decisions.

Many people are satisfied with 'good enough' when making important decisions. This book provides a method that will take you and your co-workers beyond 'good enough' to true Decision Quality.
translatedDescription:
Agregar valor con cada decisión utilizando un marco simple pero poderoso

Pocas cosas son tan valiosas en el negocio, y en la vida, como la capacidad de tomar buenas decisiones. ¿Puedes imaginar cuánto más recompensar tu vida y tu negocio sería si cada decisión que tomaste fuera la mejor? La calidad de la decisión te permite tomar la mejor opción posible y obtener más de lo que realmente quieres de cada decisión.

El Dr. Carl Spetzler es un líder en el campo de la ciencia de las decisiones y ha trabajado con organizaciones de todas las industrias para mejorar sus capacidades de toma de decisiones. Él y sus coautores, todos los consultores y educadores experimentados en este campo, le muestran cómo enmarcar un problema o oportunidad, crear un conjunto de alternativas atractivas, identificar información incierta relevante, aclarar los valores que son importantes en la decisión, aplicar herramientas de análisis y desarrollar el buy-in entre los interesados. Su enfoque sencillo es elegantemente sencillo, pero práctico y poderoso. Puede aplicarse a todo tipo de decisiones.

Nuestro negocio y nuestras vidas personales están marcadas por una corriente de decisiones. Algunos son pequeños. Algunos son grandes. Algunos están alterando la vida o son estratégicos. Qué bien tomamos esas decisiones realmente importa. Este libro te da un marco y herramientas de pensamiento que te ayudarán a mejorar las probabilidades de obtener más de lo que valoras de cada elección. Aprenderás:

Los seis requisitos para la calidad de la decisión, y cómo aplicarlos
La diferencia entre una buena decisión y un buen resultado
¿Por qué una decisión sólo puede ser tan buena como la mejor de las alternativas disponibles
Métodos para tomar decisiones "significantes" y estratégicas
Las trampas mentales que socavan la calidad de la decisión y cómo evitarlas
Cómo lidiar con la incertidumbre — un factor en cada elección importante
Cómo juzgar la calidad de una decisión en el momento en que la toma
Cómo las organizaciones se han beneficiado de crear calidad en sus decisiones.

Mucha gente está satisfecha con lo suficientemente bueno cuando toma decisiones importantes. Este libro proporciona un método que le llevará a usted y a sus compañeros de trabajo más allá de 'lo suficientemente bueno' a la verdadera calidad de decisión.

title: Visual Analytics for Dashboards: A Step-by-Step Guide to Principles and Practical Techniques
description:
This book covers the key principles, best practices, and practical techniques for designing and implementing visually compelling dashboards. It explores the various stages of the dashboard development process, from understanding user needs and defining goals, to selecting appropriate visual encodings, designing effective layouts, and employing interactive elements. It also addresses the critical aspect of data storytelling, examining how narratives and context can be woven into dashboards to deliver impactful insights and engage audiences.

Visual Analytics for Dashboards is designed to cater to a wide range of readers, from beginners looking to grasp the fundamentals of visual analytics, to seasoned professionals seeking to enhance their dashboard design skills. For different types of readers, such as a data analyst, BI professional, data scientist, or simply someone interested in data visualization, this book aims to equip them with the knowledge and tools necessary to create impactful dashboards.

What you’ll learn

The principles of data visualization

How to create effective dashboards

Meet all the requirements for visual analytics/data visualization/dashboard courses

Deepen understanding of data presentation and analysis

How to use different kinds of tools for data analysis, such as scorecards and key performance indicators

 

Who This Book Is For

Business analysts, data analysts, BI professionals, end-users, executives, developers, as well as students in dashboards, data visualizations, and visual analytics courses.

Este libro cubre los principios clave, las mejores prácticas y las técnicas prácticas para diseñar e implementar paneles visualmente convincentes. Explora las diversas etapas del proceso de desarrollo de tableros de instrumentos, desde la comprensión de las necesidades de los usuarios y la definición de los objetivos, hasta la selección de codificaciones visuales apropiadas, el diseño de diseños eficaces y el empleo de elementos interactivos. También aborda el aspecto crítico de la narración de datos, examinando cómo se pueden tejer narrativas y contexto en tableros de control para ofrecer ideas impactantes y atraer audiencias.

Visual Analytics for Dashboards está diseñado para atender a una amplia gama de lectores, desde principiantes que buscan captar los fundamentos de la analítica visual, hasta profesionales experimentados que buscan mejorar sus habilidades de diseño de panel. Para diferentes tipos de lectores, como un analista de datos, profesional de BI, científico de datos, o simplemente alguien interesado en la visualización de datos, este libro pretende equiparlos con los conocimientos y herramientas necesarios para crear paneles impactantes.

Lo que aprenderás

Principios de visualización de datos

Cómo crear paneles eficaces

Cumplir todos los requisitos para análisis visuales / cursos de visualización de datos / paneleshboard

Profundizar la comprensión de la presentación y el análisis de datos

Cómo utilizar diferentes tipos de herramientas para el análisis de datos, como tarjetas de puntuación e indicadores de rendimiento clave



Quién es este libro

Analistas de negocios, analistas de datos, profesionales de IB, usuarios finales, ejecutivos, desarrolladores, así como estudiantes en paneles, visualizaciones de datos y cursos de análisis visual.

title: Creative Writing
description: In Creative Writing: A Beginner’s Manual, the authors provide numerous and exciting exercises, classroom tutorials, activities, workshops, case studies, and interviews with creative writers from different fields, turning the book into an effective learning tool. From writing to preparing the piece for publication, Creative Writing guides the reader through every stage of the writing process. Drawing extensively from writing in Indian English that carries the flavor of plural traditions, the authors demonstrate the flexibility of English that allows it to express a multitude of cultural identities, and encourage the readers to use the language assertively to express their ideas.
translatedDescription: En Escritura Creativa: Manual de Inicio, los autores proporcionan numerosos y emocionantes ejercicios, tutoriales de aulas, actividades, talleres, estudios de casos y entrevistas con escritores creativos de diferentes campos, convirtiendo el libro en una herramienta de aprendizaje eficaz. Desde la escritura hasta la preparación de la pieza para la publicación, Escritura Creativa guía al lector a través de cada etapa del proceso de escritura. Dibujo extensamente de la escritura en inglés indio que lleva el sabor de las tradiciones plurales, los autores demuestran la flexibilidad del inglés que le permite expresar una multitud de identidades culturales, y animan a los lectores a utilizar el lenguaje de manera asertiva para expresar sus ideas.

title: Understanding Crypto Fundamentals: Value Investing in Cryptoassets and Management of Underlying Risks
description:
Saying that many investors were not convinced by cryptocurrencies in their first decade of existence would be an understatement.

Originally, author Thomas Jeegers was one of them. He looked into this new virtual money more than once and, each time, decided not to invest. Like many long-term investors, he was looking for fundamentals. Crypto had none — or so he thought. This book details why his perspective on cryptoassets has shifted – and why yours should, too.

Recent developments in this field have turned crypto from a speculative financial innovation to a new asset class, one with a new kind of fundamentals that offer real economic value. One that will change finance and investments. One that may be a trigger defining the fourth industrial revolution, the same way steam, electricity, and the Internet were triggers for the first, second, and third industrial revolutions, respectively.

Despite what advocates of the traditional financial establishmentlike to claim, cryptoassets were by far the best financial investment of the last decade, even risk-adjusted, and could still be so for the coming one. They should not be overlooked, regardless of one’s opinion of them.

This book answers the main questions any potential long-term investor in cryptoassets should ask:

What are cryptoassets and blockchain technology?
Why consider cryptoasset investments?
When is a good time to invest?
Where should one invest?
How should one invest?
Which valuation methods are appropriate?

Understanding Crypto Fundamentals includes a deep dive into the management of risks specific to cryptoassets, both financial and non-financial, and provides the tools needed for investment success in this new asset class. Upon completing the book, you will have a new perspective on cryptoassets and how you can benefit from them as an investor.
Thomas Jeegers is a CFA Charterholder and Financial Risk Manager (FRM), and has earned an MBA from INSEAD as well as multiple blockchain certifications from institutions including INSEAD and Oxford University. He has worked in finance for 10 years and is a frequent speaker at events on blockchain and cryptoassets.
translatedDescription:
Decir que muchos inversionistas no estaban convencidos por criptomonedas en su primera década de existencia sería una subestimación.

Originalmente, el autor Thomas Jeegers fue uno de ellos. Miró a este nuevo dinero virtual más de una vez y, cada vez, decidió no invertir. Como muchos inversores a largo plazo, estaba buscando fundamentos. Crypto no tenía ninguno, o así pensaba. Este libro detalla por qué su perspectiva sobre criptoassets ha cambiado – y por qué la suya también debería.

Los acontecimientos recientes en este campo han pasado de una innovación financiera especulativa a una nueva clase de activos, una con un nuevo tipo de fundamentos que ofrecen un valor económico real. Uno que cambiará las finanzas y las inversiones. Uno que puede ser un desencadenante que define la cuarta revolución industrial, de la misma manera el vapor, la electricidad y la Internet fueron disparadores para las revoluciones industriales primera, segunda y tercera, respectivamente.

A pesar de los defensores de los establecimientos financieros tradicionales como para reclamar, los criptoassets eran, con mucho, la mejor inversión financiera de la última década, incluso ajustada a los riesgos, y todavía podría ser así para la próxima. No deben ser ignorados, independientemente de su opinión.

Este libro responde a las preguntas principales cualquier potencial inversor a largo plazo en cryptoassets debe preguntar:

¿Qué son las criptoassets y la tecnología de blockchain?
¿Por qué considerar inversiones criptoasset?
¿Cuándo es un buen momento para invertir?
¿Dónde debería invertir uno?
¿Cómo se debe invertir?
¿Qué métodos de valoración son apropiados?

Comprender Fundamentos Crypto incluye una profunda inmersión en la gestión de riesgos específicos para criptoassets, tanto financieros como no financieros, y proporciona las herramientas necesarias para el éxito de la inversión en esta nueva clase de activos. Al completar el libro, tendrá una nueva perspectiva sobre criptoassets y cómo puede beneficiarse de ellos como inversor.
Thomas Jeegers es titular de la Carta de la CFA y gerente de riesgo financiero (FRM), y ha ganado un MBA de INSEAD, así como múltiples certificaciones de blockchain de instituciones como INSEAD y Oxford University. Ha trabajado en finanzas durante 10 años y es un orador frecuente en eventos en blockchain y criptoassets.

title: The Dart Programming Language
description:
Dart is a class-based, object-oriented language that simplifies the development of structured modern apps, scales from small scripts to large applications, and can be compiled to JavaScript for use in any modern browser. In this rigorous but readable introductory text, Dart specification lead Gilad Bracha fully explains both the language and the ideas that have shaped it.

The Dart Programming Language offers an authoritative description of Dart for programmers, computer science students, and other well-qualified professionals. The text illuminates key programming constructs with significant examples, focusing on principles of the language, such as optional typing and pure object-orientation.

Bracha thoroughly explains reflection in Dart, showing how it is evolving into a form that programmers can easily apply without creating excessively large programs. He also shares valuable insights into Dart’s actor-style model for concurrency and asynchronous programming. Throughout, he covers both language semantics and the rationale for key features, helping you understand not just what Dart does, but why it works the way it does.

You will learn about

Dart’s object model, in which everything is an object, even numbers and Boolean values

How Dart programs are organized into modular libraries

How Dart functions are structured, stored in variables, passed as parameters, and returned as results

Dart’s innovative approach to optional typing

How Dart handles expressions and statements

How to use Dart’s implementation of reflection to introspect on libraries, classes, functions, and objects

Isolates and other Dart features that support concurrency and distribution

Register your product at informit.com/register for convenient access to downloads, updates, and corrections as they become available.
translatedDescription:
Dart es un lenguaje basado en clases, orientado hacia objetos que simplifica el desarrollo de aplicaciones modernas estructuradas, escalas de pequeños scripts a grandes aplicaciones, y se puede compilar a JavaScript para su uso en cualquier navegador moderno. En este texto introductorio riguroso pero legible, la especificación Dart lidera Gilad Bracha explica completamente tanto el lenguaje como las ideas que lo han moldeado.

El Dart Programming Language ofrece una descripción autorizada de Dart para programadores, estudiantes de informática y otros profesionales bien calificados. El texto ilumina los constructos clave de programación con ejemplos significativos, centrándose en los principios del lenguaje, como la escritura opcional y la orientación pura del objeto.

Bracha explica a fondo la reflexión en Dart, mostrando cómo está evolucionando en una forma que los programadores pueden aplicar fácilmente sin crear programas excesivamente grandes. También comparte valiosas ideas sobre el modelo de actor de Dart para la concurrencia y la programación asincrónica. A lo largo, cubre tanto la semántica del lenguaje como la racionalidad de las características clave, ayudándote a entender no sólo lo que Dart hace, sino por qué funciona de la manera que lo hace.

Usted aprenderá sobre

Modelo de objeto de Dart, en el que todo es un objeto, incluso números y valores booleanos

Cómo los programas Dart se organizan en bibliotecas modulares

Cómo las funciones Dart están estructuradas, almacenadas en variables, pasadas como parámetros, y devueltas como resultados

Enfoque innovador de Dart para la clasificación opcional

Cómo Dart maneja expresiones y declaraciones

Cómo utilizar la aplicación de reflexión de Dart para introspeccionar bibliotecas, clases, funciones y objetos

Resueltos y otras características de Dart que soportan la concurrencia y distribución

Registrar su producto en informit.com/register para un acceso conveniente a descargas, actualizaciones y correcciones cuando estén disponibles.

title: Behavior-Driven Development with Cucumber: Better Collaboration for Better Software
description:
Master BDD to deliver higher-value software more quickly

To develop high-value products quickly, software development teams need better ways to collaborate. Agile methods like Scrum and Kanban are helpful, but they're not enough. Teams need better ways to work inside each sprint or work item. Behavior-driven development (BDD) adds just enough structure for product experts, testers, and developers to collaborate more effectively.

Drawing on extensive experience helping teams adopt BDD, Richard Lawrence and Paul Rayner show how to explore changes in system behavior with examples through conversations, how to capture your examples in expressive language, and how to flow the results into effective automated testing with Cucumber. Where most BDD resources focus on test automation, this guide goes deep into how BDD changes team collaboration and what that collaboration looks like day to day. Concrete examples and practical advice will prepare you to succeed with BDD, whatever your context or role.

· Learn how to collaborate better by using concrete examples of system behavior

· Identify your project's meaningful increment of value so you're always working on something important

· Begin experimenting with BDD slowly and at low risk

· Move smoothly from informal examples to automated tests in Cucumber

· Use BDD to deliver more frequently with greater visibility

· Make Cucumber scenarios more expressive to ensure you're building the right thing

· Grow a Cucumber suite that acts as high-value living documentation

· Sustainably work with complex scenario data

· Get beyond the "mini-waterfalls" that often arise on Scrum teams
translatedDescription:
Master BDD para ofrecer software de mayor valor más rápido

Para desarrollar productos de alto valor rápidamente, los equipos de desarrollo de software necesitan mejores formas de colaborar. Los métodos ágiles como Scrum y Kanban son útiles, pero no son suficientes. Los equipos necesitan mejores formas de trabajar dentro de cada sprint o artículo de trabajo. El desarrollo impulsado por el comportamiento (BDD) añade una estructura suficiente para que expertos en productos, probadores y desarrolladores colaboren más eficazmente.

Basándose en una amplia experiencia ayudando a los equipos a adoptar BDD, Richard Lawrence y Paul Rayner muestran cómo explorar cambios en el comportamiento del sistema con ejemplos a través de conversaciones, cómo capturar sus ejemplos en lenguaje expresivo, y cómo fluir los resultados en pruebas automatizadas eficaces con Cucumber. Cuando la mayoría de los recursos de BDD se centran en la automatización de pruebas, esta guía profundiza en cómo BDD cambia la colaboración de equipo y cómo se ve esa colaboración día a día. Ejemplos concretos y consejos prácticos te prepararán para tener éxito con BDD, sea cual sea tu contexto o papel.

· Aprender a colaborar mejor utilizando ejemplos concretos de comportamiento del sistema

· Identificar el aumento significativo del valor de tu proyecto, así que siempre estás trabajando en algo importante

· Comience a experimentar con BDD lentamente y bajo riesgo

· Mover sin problemas de ejemplos informales a pruebas automatizadas en Cucumber

· Use BDD para ofrecer con más frecuencia con mayor visibilidad

· Hacer escenarios de pepino más expresivo para asegurar que usted está construyendo lo correcto

· Crece una suite pepinosa que actúa como documentación viva de alto valor

· Trabajar sosteniblemente con datos de escenario complejos

· Más allá de las "mini cascadas" que a menudo surgen en los equipos Scrum

title: Mastering Customer Success
description:
Mastering Customer Success provides a thorough exploration into the practices and strategies essential for excelling in customer success management. Through case studies, expert insights, and practical advice, you will learn how to decrease churn, expand revenue streams, and build resilient CS organizations. This book is a vital guide to becoming a leader in fostering customer relationships.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and implement strategies for effective customer engagement to decrease churn.
Learn techniques to segment accounts and design processes to align customer needs with business goals.
Master the development of actionable playbooks to enhance the efficiency of your CS operations.
Gain insights on leveraging technology and collaboration to enhance customer value and experience.
Become proficient in methodologies for creating ideal customer profiles to tailor engagement strategies.

Author(s)

Jeff Mar and Peter Armaly are recognized experts and consultants in Customer Success. With years of experience leading and advising CS teams, their practical knowledge enriches every chapter. Their collaborative approach brings a wealth of industry experience to help professionals succeed in demanding customer-facing roles.

Mastering Customer Success is designed for professionals in customer success roles, from aspiring CSMs to seasoned managers, looking to deepen their expertise. This book is perfect if you are familiar with B2B environments and basic CS concepts and want to elevate your strategic impact. It is ideal for those aiming for measurable improvement in customer relationships and organizational growth.

title: Learn Ethereum - Second Edition

Learn Ethereum provides a practical, comprehensive guide for developers to create and manage decentralized applications using Ethereum 2.0. By diving into its mechanics, tools, and frameworks, you will gain the skills needed to understand the Ethereum ecosystem and build powerful, scalable decentralized applications.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the fundamentals of blockchain technology and Ethereum's ecosystem.
Gain proficiency in Solidity and smart contract development.
Create, test, and deploy end-to-end decentralized applications.
Explore advanced topics like NFTs, DeFi, and Layer 2 scaling.
Set up and manage private Ethereum blockchains.

Author(s)

Xun (Brian) Wu, Zhihong Zou, and Dongying Song bring deep technical expertise and practical experience with blockchain and distributed technologies. They are educators and developers devoted to helping others grasp Ethereum's potential. Their approachable writing style ensures concepts are easy to follow and apply.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for developers and architects eager to learn Ethereum from the ground up, regardless of whether they are experienced in blockchain. Beginners to smart contracts with basic programming knowledge in JavaScript or similar languages will find a solid starting point, while intermediate developers can expand their expertise to develop robust DApps.

title: Effective Remote Work
description:
The office isn't as essential as it used to be. Flexible working hours and distributed teams are replacing decades of on-site, open-plan office culture. Wherever you work from nowadays, your colleagues are likely to be somewhere else. No more whiteboards. No more water coolers. And certainly no Ping-Pong. So how can you organize yourself, ship software, communicate, and be impactful as part of a globally distributed workforce? We'll show you how. It's time to adopt a brand new mindset. Remote working is here to stay. Come and join us.

Remote working is on the rise. Whether or not we are remote workers, it is likely we are all part of a global workforce. We need to learn to interact remotely, because we are all remote from someone in some way. Rather than simply simulating the way we'd usually work together via digital means, we have to learn new communication skills and adopt a different mindset in order to work remotely effectively, efficiently, and, most importantly, healthily.

We'll start by getting you set up with the right equipment and habits. Then, we'll learn the mindset of treating everyone as remote, and conquer both synchronous and asynchronous communication. You'll learn how to produce amazing artifacts, how to communicate clearly, and how to manage yourself and your teams. Then we'll look at the bigger picture: from measuring the remote readiness of your workplace, to creating a handbook for your team, to exploring remote-first culture and tackling burnout and mental well-being.

Fundamentally we'll see that adopting a remote-working mindset can do wonders for our organization, our effectiveness, and our impact in our careers. It can even create a more diverse and inclusive industry for us all to work in.

So what are you waiting for? The remote future is now. Be a part of it.

What You Need:

There are no prerequisites to reading this book, other than having had some experience of working in the software industry and a healthy curiosity.
translatedDescription:
La oficina no es tan esencial como solía ser. Las horas de trabajo flexibles y los equipos distribuidos están reemplazando décadas de cultura de oficinas in situ y de planta abierta. Dondequiera que trabajes desde hoy, tus colegas probablemente estarán en otro lugar. No más pizarras. No más refrigeradores de agua. Y sin duda ningún Ping-Pong. ¿Cómo puedes organizarte, enviar software, comunicarte y ser impactante como parte de una fuerza laboral distribuida globalmente? Te mostraremos cómo. Es hora de adoptar una nueva mentalidad. El trabajo remoto está aquí para quedarse. Ven y únete a nosotros.

El trabajo a distancia está en aumento. Si somos o no trabajadores remotos, es probable que todos somos parte de una fuerza laboral global. Necesitamos aprender a interactuar remotamente, porque todos estamos alejados de alguien de alguna manera. En lugar de simular simplemente la forma en que solíamos trabajar juntos por medios digitales, tenemos que aprender nuevas habilidades de comunicación y adoptar una mentalidad diferente para trabajar de manera remota, eficiente y, lo más importante, saludable.

Empezaremos por arreglarte con el equipo y los hábitos adecuados. Entonces, aprenderemos la mentalidad de tratar a todos como remotos, y conquistaremos tanto la comunicación sincronizada como asincrónica. Aprenderás a producir artefactos increíbles, a comunicarse con claridad y a gestionarte a ti mismo y a tus equipos. Luego vamos a ver la imagen más grande: desde la medición de la disposición remota de su lugar de trabajo, hasta la creación de un manual para su equipo, para explorar la cultura remota primera y hacer frente al agotamiento y el bienestar mental.

Fundamentalmente veremos que adoptar una mentalidad de trabajo remoto puede hacer maravillas para nuestra organización, nuestra eficacia y nuestro impacto en nuestras carreras. Incluso puede crear una industria más diversa e incluyente para que todos trabajemos.

Entonces, ¿qué estás esperando? El futuro remoto es ahora. Sé parte de ello.

Lo que necesitas:

No hay requisitos para leer este libro, aparte de haber tenido alguna experiencia de trabajar en la industria del software y una sana curiosidad.

title: Dramatic Storytelling and Narrative Design, 2nd Edition
description: This book provides an industry professional's first-hand perspective on narrative design's practical usage, day-to-day roles and responsibilities, and keys to breaking in and succeeding. The book delves into the foundations of compelling storytelling through structural analysis and character archetype breakdowns.

El libro profundiza en los cimientos de la narración convincente a través de análisis estructural y descomposición de arquetipos de carácter.

title: Salesforce Anti-Patterns - Second Edition
description:
Get ready to dive into common pitfalls in Salesforce implementation with "Salesforce Anti-Patterns." This book offers a detailed look at typical mistakes in Salesforce architecture and provides actionable solutions. From a certified expert in the field, you'll gain insights to design and implement robust, scalable, and efficient Salesforce solutions.

What this Book will help me do

Understand common Salesforce architectural errors and improve your designs.
Learn best practices for Salesforce data modeling and governance.
Develop strategies to address key data architecture challenges.
Gain expertise in deployment, testing, and governance solutions.
Leverage emerging technologies like AI in Salesforce architecture.

Author(s)

Lars Malmqvist is a 33-time Salesforce Certified Technical Architect with years of hands-on experience in Salesforce implementation and training. Passionate about teaching architectural best practices, Lars shares expert advice on designing and maintaining resilient Salesforce ecosystems. This book represents his commitment to elevating the skillsets of Salesforce professionals.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for Salesforce architects, aspiring architects, developers, and consultants who want to enhance their Salesforce solution designs and avoid common architectural pitfalls. Ideal for professional growth or preparing for advanced certifications like the CTA, readers should already have a foundational knowledge of the Salesforce platform.

De un experto certificado en el campo, obtendrá información para diseñar e implementar soluciones robustas, escalables y eficientes de Salesforce.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprenda errores arquitectónicos comunes de Salesforce y mejore sus diseños.

title: Culture Design
description:
Strong cultures don't emerge by accident. They're built—with clarity, consistency, and design. This is your guide.

Today's leaders are navigating a storm of competing demands: rising economic and social pressures, rapid technological disruption, and a workforce that expects greater purpose and accountability than ever before. In this unpredictable climate, a weak culture erodes trust, loyalty, and performance. A strong one, by contrast, makes the difference between clarity and confusion, resilience and fragility.

It's time to get intentional about your company's culture.

In this practical and inspiring book, you'll find a clear, actionable framework—rooted in design thinking and inclusive leadership—to help you shape a culture that’s resilient, empowering, and built to last.

Culture Design brings together James D. White's expert perspective, informed by more than thirty years of operating experience across sectors and in the boardroom, with his daughter Krista White's millennial perspective of modern workers' expectations from their company and its culture. This powerful combination produces a masterful joint outlook on what makes leaders best suited to build cultures that work for all.

Together they've written an essential book with one central message: culture design is an indispensable pillar of strategy for organizations to thrive in the coming decades and beyond.
translatedDescription:
Las culturas fuertes no emergen por accidente. Están construidos con claridad, consistencia y diseño. Este es tu guía.

Los líderes de hoy están navegando una tormenta de demandas competitivas: crecientes presiones económicas y sociales, rápida perturbación tecnológica y una fuerza laboral que espera un mayor propósito y responsabilidad que nunca antes. En este clima impredecible, una cultura débil erosiona la confianza, la lealtad y el rendimiento. Una fuerte, por contraste, marca la diferencia entre claridad y confusión, resiliencia y fragilidad.

Es hora de ser intencional sobre la cultura de su empresa.

En este libro práctico e inspirador, encontrarás un marco claro y accionable, arraigado en el pensamiento de diseño y en el liderazgo inclusivo, para ayudarte a formar una cultura resiliente, empoderante y construida para durar.

Cultura Diseño reúne la perspectiva experta de James D. White, informada por más de treinta años de experiencia operativa en sectores y en la sala de juntas, con la perspectiva milenaria de su hija Krista White de las expectativas de los trabajadores modernos desde su empresa y su cultura. Esta poderosa combinación produce una perspectiva conjunta magistral sobre lo que hace a los líderes más adecuados para construir culturas que funcionen para todos.

Juntos han escrito un libro esencial con un mensaje central: el diseño cultural es un pilar indispensable de la estrategia para que las organizaciones prosperen en las próximas décadas y más allá.

title: The Activator Advantage
description:
A proven approach used by today's best professional service partners to win, retain, and grow client relationships.

There is a growing problem in the professional services industry that is often acknowledged but rarely discussed: clients—even long-standing ones for whom firms have consistently delivered unquestioned value—are much less loyal to those firms and partners than they once were. This dramatic shift in client behavior has rendered traditional approaches to business development not only ineffective but counterproductive.

But top performers have figured out a radical new approach that is redefining what it means to be a rainmaker in today's professional services market.

Drawing on a comprehensive, quantitative study of nearly three thousand partners—spanning law, accounting, consulting, investment banking, executive search, and public relations—The Activator Advantage identifies five types of partners found across the professional services landscape and shows how only one of them—the Activator—drives consistent growth.

Activators deeply embed business development habits into their daily workflow, aggressively leverage their internal and external networks, and proactively deliver both business and personal value to clients—all of which not only helps shield them from the vagaries of modern client buying behavior but also lays the groundwork for more loyal, longer-lasting relationships.

Packed with eye-opening data, counterintuitive insights, and robust case examples, The Activator Advantage provides the road map for any professional services partner or firm leader looking to chart a path to greater client engagement, internal collaboration, and firm profitability in the new era of fading client loyalty.

title: How to Launch a Token: An Essential Guide for the Uninitiated
description:
Take a deep dive into the intricacies of launching and successfully managing a cryptocurrency token. This book is an indispensable resource, providing invaluable insights and practical advice.

Spanning 12 chapters, the book begins with the fundamentals, explaining the different types of tokens and the core concepts of crypto projects, guiding readers through the critical decision-making process about the necessity and role of a token in their venture. As the narrative progresses, you are taken on a journey through the lifecycle of a crypto project. It emphasizes the importance of a well-thought-out roadmap, a compelling pitch deck, and the crucial process of assembling a skilled team.

Diving deeper, the book explores the complex world of tokenomics, reviewing the various economic models behind tokens and how to tailor them to specific projects. A key aspect of this guide is its focus on go-to-market strategies, including targeting the right audience, effective marketing techniques, and the vital role of community building. Additionally, it addresses the essentials of fundraising in the crypto space, highlighting the types of investors to approach and strategies for engaging them effectively.

Security and stability are paramount in the crypto world. The book provides a detailed analysis of the storage and custody of funds, comparing centralized and decentralized mechanisms and emphasizing the importance of robust security measures. This is crucial for ensuring liquidity and accessibility of the token in the market. The guide culminates with a focus on the launch day, detailing the preparation, organization, and key considerations to ensure a successful token launch. When done you’ll be well-equipped to navigate the complex and exciting world of cryptocurrency token launches.

What You’ll Learn

Develop a successful launch strategy for a token.
Prepare the decks and documents for a successful token campaign.
Discover negotiation tactics required to reduce fees for all your counterparts.
Explore techniques required to maintain the health and popularity of your token.

Who This Book Is For

Those considering launching a token, companies looking to tokenize assets, accelerators and incubators, advisors and blockchain teachers/professors, and crypto firms as part of their onboarding material.

title: Learn Enough HTML, CSS and Layout to Be Dangerous: An Introduction to Modern Website Creation and Templating Systems
description:
All You Need to Know, and Nothing You Don’t, to Start Creating and Deploying Web Sites---In Full Color To design, build, and deploy modern websites, you need three core skills: the ability to write and edit HTML, wield CSS to control page design, and create efficient web layouts that serve users well. But you don’t need to learn "everything" about HTML, CSS and web layout, just how to use them efficiently to solve real problems. Focused exercises help you internalize what matters, without wasting time on details pros don’t care about. Soon, it’ll be like you were born knowing this stuff--and you’ll be suddenly, seriously dangerous.

Learn enough about . . .

Deploying a simple but real website to the live Web right away

Adding advanced styling to websites, including CSS Flexbox and CSS Grid

Installing and configuring Jekyll, a static site generator

Getting started with templating systems and programming languages

Mastering key layout principles for web design

Registering and configuring custom domains, with custom URLs and email addresses

Setting up analytics to better understand your sites visitors

Making all these technologies work well together

title: Getting Started with Salesforce CRM Analytics: A Beginner’s Guide to Building Interactive and Complex Dashboards
description:
Dive into the intricate world of salesforce CRM Analytics and harness the power of interactive and complex dashboards. This book will empower you to unlock the full potential of Salesforce CRM Analytics and enhance your ability to generate meaningful insights for strategic decision-making.

Developed by Salesforce to transcend the limitations of standard reports and dashboards, CRM Analytics introduces a new platform that requires a fresh perspective for those familiar with the traditional Salesforce platform. Using a hands-on approach, this step-by-step book unravels the complexities of CRM Analytics, guiding you through the process of acquiring data from the Salesforce platform, importing external data like CSV files, and preparing the data for dashboard creation. You’ll also learn to build dashboards from scratch, explore lenses, and delve into the depths of SAQL (Salesforce Analytics Query Language) and binding.

CRM Analytics has a steeper learning curve than standard Salesforce reporting. Getting Started with Salesforce CRM Analytics will guide you through the journey of constructing dashboards, from data preparation to the final dashboard creation.

What You Will Learn

Understand CRM Analytics as a platform, including permission and licensing
Get data into the CRM Analytics platform and transform data loaded
Build dashboards using CRM Analytics
Explore and analyze data using CRM Analytics
Utilize SAQL and binding to create advance dashboards

Who This Book Is For

IT users getting started with CRM Analytics, Salesforce consultants starting new CRM Analytics projects, and power users familiar with Salesforce reporting and dashboards who want to get up to speed on advanced analytics features.

Gain expertise in managing multi-currency and tax mechanisms efficiently within enterprise systems.
Understand financial forecasting, budgeting, and expenditures tailored for accurate and practical accounting.

title: New Threats to the Subscription Model
description: Proponents of the subscription model argue that it offers customers a better user experience and a lower barrier to access, while providers gain predictability and ease of communication with customers. But the risks of supply chain disruption and inflation are calling into question vendors’ ability to fulfill their service commitments to customers — and retain them — over the long term.
translatedDescription: Los proponentes del modelo de suscripción argumentan que ofrece a los clientes una mejor experiencia de usuario y una menor barrera de acceso, mientras que los proveedores ganan previsibilidad y facilidad de comunicación con los clientes. Pero los riesgos de la interrupción de la cadena de suministro y la inflación están poniendo en duda la capacidad de los proveedores de cumplir sus compromisos de servicio con los clientes —y retenerlos— a largo plazo.

title: Seven Reasons to Strengthen Your Customer Benefits Focus
description: Customers don’t want your product: They want your product’s benefits. However, many companies and marketing leaders still fail to appreciate how focusing on customer benefits can unlock new opportunities — for innovation, customer satisfaction, and growth. Learn seven significant reasons why you should put customer benefits first, as well as key questions to ask about your customer benefits focus.
translatedDescription: Los clientes no quieren su producto: Quieren los beneficios de su producto. Sin embargo, muchas empresas y líderes de marketing todavía no aprecian cómo enfocarse en los beneficios del cliente puede desbloquear nuevas oportunidades, para la innovación, la satisfacción del cliente y el crecimiento. Aprenda siete razones significativas por las que debe poner los beneficios del cliente primero, así como preguntas clave para hacer acerca de su enfoque de beneficios del cliente.

title: How to Heal a Workplace
description:
Boost wellbeing and build a robust, productive culture in your workplace

Your workplace’s most powerful resource is its people. That’s why it’s critical to balance the needs of your business with the needs of the employees who make that business happen every day. At the heart of the matter is your workplace culture: the environments and relationships that shape your business, whether physical or virtual. How to Heal a Workplace shares the insights and hands-on advice that you need to better understand how your culture impacts your team. You’ll learn how to manage interpersonal challenges—and anticipate the impact of policies and procedures—to create a healthier, happier and more productive environment.

Drawing on real-world stories from diverse industries, in-demand workplace mental health consultant Kerry Howard shares strategies that will help you:

Boost employee wellbeing, and attract and retain staff by supporting their mental health
Understand how trauma is caused by everyday events and how this impacts the workplace
Combat bullying and harassment and prevent workplace injuries
Foster psychological safety, improve communication, and build better relationships between colleagues

In How to Heal a Workplace, you’ll find the practical advice you need to create a better culture, improve productivity and increase satisfaction across every area of your business.
translatedDescription:
Aumentar el bienestar y construir una cultura robusta y productiva en su lugar de trabajo

En el centro de la materia está su cultura laboral: los ambientes y las relaciones que dan forma a su negocio, ya sea física o virtual. Cómo curar un lugar de trabajo comparte las ideas y consejos prácticos que necesita para entender mejor cómo su cultura impacta a su equipo. Aprenderás a gestionar los desafíos interpersonales, y anticiparás el impacto de las políticas y procedimientos, para crear un entorno más saludable, más feliz y más productivo.

Basándose en historias reales de diversas industrias, el consultor de salud mental en el lugar de trabajo Kerry Howard comparte estrategias que le ayudarán:

Aumentar el bienestar de los empleados y atraer y retener al personal apoyando su salud mental
Entender cómo el trauma es causado por los acontecimientos cotidianos y cómo esto afecta al lugar de trabajo
Combatir la intimidación y el acoso y prevenir lesiones en el lugar de trabajo
Fomentar la seguridad psicológica, mejorar la comunicación y construir mejores relaciones entre colegas

En Cómo curar un lugar de trabajo, encontrará el consejo práctico que necesita para crear una mejor cultura, mejorar la productividad y aumentar la satisfacción en cada área de su negocio.

title: The Customer-Driven Playbook
description:
Despite the wide acceptance of Lean approaches and customer-development strategies, many product teams still have difficulty putting these principles into meaningful action. That’s where The Customer-Driven Playbook comes in. This practical guide provides a complete end-to-end process that will help you understand customers, identify their problems, conceptualize new ideas, and create fantastic products they’ll love.

To build successful products, you need to continually test your assumptions about your customers and the products you build. This book shows team leads, researchers, designers, and managers how to use the Hypothesis Progression Framework (HPF) to formulate, experiment with, and make sense of critical customer and product assumptions at every stage. With helpful tips, real-world examples, and complete guides, you’ll quickly learn how to turn Lean theory into action.

Collect and formulate your assumptions into hypotheses that can be tested to unlock meaningful insights
Conduct experiments to create a continual cadence of learning
Derive patterns and meaning from the feedback you’ve collected from customers
Improve your confidence when making strategic business and product decisions
Track the progression of your assumptions, hypotheses, early ideas, concepts, and product features with step-by-step playbooks
Improve customer satisfaction by creating a consistent feedback loop
translatedDescription:

Ahí es donde entra el libro de juegos con clientes. Esta guía práctica proporciona un proceso completo de extremo a extremo que le ayudará a entender a los clientes, identificar sus problemas, conceptualizar nuevas ideas y crear productos fantásticos que les encantará.

Para construir productos exitosos, necesita probar continuamente sus suposiciones sobre sus clientes y los productos que construye. Este libro muestra a los líderes del equipo, investigadores, diseñadores y administradores cómo utilizar el Marco de Progresión de Hipotesis (HPF) para formular, experimentar con y tener sentido de las asunciones críticas de clientes y productos en cada etapa. Con consejos útiles, ejemplos del mundo real y guías completas, aprenderá rápidamente cómo convertir la teoría de Lean en acción.

Recopilar y formular sus suposiciones en hipótesis que pueden ser probadas para desbloquear ideas significativas
Realizar experimentos para crear una cadencia continua de aprendizaje
Patrones y significados de la retroalimentación que ha recogido de los clientes
Mejora tu confianza al tomar decisiones estratégicas de negocios y productos
Seguimiento de la progresión de sus suposiciones, hipótesis, ideas tempranas, conceptos y características de producto con libros de juego paso a paso
Mejorar la satisfacción del cliente creando un bucle de retroalimentación consistente

title: Designing Delivery
description:
Now that we’re moving from a product economy to a digital service economy, software is becoming critical for navigating our everyday lives. The quality of your service depends on how well it helps customers accomplish goals and satisfy needs. Service quality is not about designing capabilities, but about making—and keeping—promises to customers.

To help you improve customer satisfaction and create positive brand experiences, this pragmatic book introduces a transdisciplinary approach to digital service delivery. Designing a resilient service today requires a unified effort across front-office and back-office functions and technical and business perspectives. You’ll learn how make IT a full partner in the ongoing conversations you have with your customers.

Take a unique customer-centered approach to the entire service delivery lifecycle
Apply this perspective across development, operations, QA, design, project management, and marketing
Implement a specific quality assurance methodology that unifies those disciplines
Use the methodology to achieve true resilience, not just stability

title: Transform Customer Experience

Your customers are your future.

Smartphones, social media and the internet have given customers access to more information than ever before. If your business fails them, they will switch to your competitor and never return. So how do you keep them? By mapping their journeys, identifying potential hazards and reshaping your business with customer experience (CX) at its heart. 

From services to products, online to in-person, small-scale to multinational, your customers’ loyalty depends on how you interact with them. Transform Customer Experience is your ultimate guide to putting your customer first. • Discusses the implications of customers’ omnichannel engagement

• Addresses the importance of positive employee experience in establishing a supportive CX culture.

Better still, any business that deals with people--employees or customers--can adopt the techniques to achieve Apple-like market dominance by enriching lives, building loyalty, and reimagining the customer experience.

title: Managing Expectations: Working with People Who Want More, Better, Faster, Sooner, NOW!

But sometimes your expectations of them seem just as unreasonable (in their eyes). The problem is that these mismatched expectations can lead to misunderstandings, frayed nerves, and ruffled feathers. More seriously, they often lead to flawed systems, failed projects, and a drain on resources. Managing Expectations shows how to identify expectations and suggests ways to gain more control of them. In today's turbulent business world, understanding and meeting your customers' expectations is indeed a challenge, and it's not hard to understand why: Expectations affect a range of interactions, including service responsiveness, service capability, product functionality, and project success. Expectations are difficult to control and impossible to turn off. However, by learning to identify and influence what your customers expect, you can dramatically improve the quality, impact, and effectiveness of your services. Contents include sections on communication skills, information gathering, policies and practices, building win-win relationships, as well as a concluding chapter on how to formulate an action plan. title: Spiritual Capital
description: Our capitalist culture and the business practices that operate within it are in crisis. Capitalism as we know it today—an amoral culture of short-term self-interest, profit maximization, emphasis on shareholder value, isolationist thinking, and profligate disregard of long-term consequences—is an unsustainable system, a monster set to consume itself.Danah Zohar and Ian Marshall argue that a critical mass of individuals acting from higher motivations can make a difference. They offer a radically new philosophy for corporate governance that alters the meaning and purpose of business and wealth creation. They describe a values-based business culture that focuses on the accumulation of “spiritual capital” rather than material capital. Rather than strictly benefiting shareholders, spiritual capital benefits all stakeholders—including the whole human race, present and future, and the planet itself. Spiritual capital nourishes and sustains the human spirit. Danah Zohar and Ian Marshall introduce the concept of spiritual intelligence (SQ), and describe how it can be used to shift individuals and our culture from a state of acting from lower motivations (fear, greed, anger, and self-assertion) to one of acting from higher motivations (exploration, cooperation, power-within, mastery, and higher service). They show how this shift actually happens in a given organizational culture. They look in depth at the issues that dominate corporate culture and examine the role of the leadership elite who must be the ones to bring about and embody this cultural shift. Finally, Zohar and Marshall argue that spiritual capital is a valid and workable form of capitalism and detail what we, as individuals, can do to make it happen.
translatedDescription: Nuestra cultura capitalista y las prácticas empresariales que operan dentro de ella están en crisis. El capitalismo como lo conocemos hoy —una cultura amoral del interés propio a corto plazo, la maximización de las ganancias, el énfasis en el valor de accionista, el pensamiento aislacionista y el desprecio de las consecuencias a largo plazo— es un sistema insostenible, un monstruo dispuesto a consumirse. Danah Zohar e Ian Marshall argumentan que una masa crítica de individuos que actúan desde motivaciones superiores puede hacer una diferencia. Ofrecen una filosofía radicalmente nueva para la gobernanza corporativa que altera el significado y propósito de la creación de negocios y riqueza. Describen una cultura empresarial basada en valores que se centra en la acumulación de “capital espiritual” en lugar de capital material. En lugar de beneficiar estrictamente a los accionistas, el capital espiritual beneficia a todos los interesados, incluyendo a toda la raza humana, presente y futuro, y al planeta mismo. El capital espiritual alimenta y sostiene el espíritu humano. Danah Zohar e Ian Marshall introducen el concepto de inteligencia espiritual (SQ), y describen cómo se puede utilizar para cambiar a los individuos y nuestra cultura de un estado de actuar de las motivaciones inferiores (temor, codicia, ira y autoafirmación) a uno de actuar de motivaciones superiores (exploración, cooperación, poder dentro, dominio y servicio superior). Muestran cómo este cambio realmente sucede en una determinada cultura organizativa. Miran en profundidad las cuestiones que dominan la cultura corporativa y examinan el papel de la élite de liderazgo que debe ser la que debe ser la que trae y encarna este cambio cultural. Finalmente, Zohar y Marshall argumentan que el capital espiritual es una forma válida y viable del capitalismo y detallan lo que nosotros, como individuos, podemos hacer para que suceda.

title: Allyship Actually - Why it’s ‘We’ and not ‘Me’
description:
The Oxford Learner’s Dictionary defines allyship as:

 

“the state of being an ally (= a person who helps and supports somebody) to a particular group of people that you yourself do not belong to, in order to help ensure their basic rights and ability to be happy and successful in society”

 

This book exposes the problems that arise from a patriarchal or narrow-minded work culture. It tells the story of professionals in multiple industries where they are confronted by male dominance or discrimination. We see how characters become allies for each other to support personal and professional development.

 

Allyship Actually follows Lucy – a spirited newcomer to the tech industry – and David – a seasoned professional – as their paths and those of other characters cross in unexpected ways, against a bustling London backdrop.

 

The characters’ careers develop amid toxic cultures. Based on real-life events, the narrative gives a vivid depiction of Lucy and David’s frustration with outdated work cultures, and their efforts to support colleagues suffering inequity or harassment.

Este libro expone los problemas que surgen de una cultura de trabajo patriarcal o estrecha. title: Time and Timelessness
description:
Time and Timelessness examines the development of Jung's understanding of time throughout his opus, and the ways in which this concept has affected key elements of his work. In this book Yiassemides suggests that temporality plays an important role in many of Jung's central ideas, and is closely interlinked with his overall approach to the psyche and the cosmos at large.

Jung proposed a profound truth: that time is relative at large. To appreciate the whole of our experience we must reach beyond causality and temporal linearity, to develop an approach that allows for multidimensional and synchronistic experiences. Jung’s understanding surpassed Freud's dichotomous approach which restricted timelessness to the unconscious; his time theory allows us to reach beyond the everyday time-bound world into a greater realm, rich with meaning and connection.

Included in the book:

-Jung’s time theory

-the death of time

-time and spatial metaphors

-the role of time in precognition, telepathy and synchronicity -Unus mundus and time

-a comparison of Freud’s and Jung’s time theories: temporal directionality, dimensionality, and the role of timelessness.

This book is the first to explore time and timelessness in a systematic manner from a Jungian perspective, and the first to investigate how the concept of time affected the overall development of Jung's theory. It will be key reading for psychoanalytic scholars and clinicians, as well as those working in the field of phenomenological philosophy.
translatedDescription:
El tiempo y la intemporalidad examinan el desarrollo de la comprensión del tiempo de Jung a lo largo de su obra, y las formas en que este concepto ha afectado elementos clave de su trabajo. En este libro Yiassemides sugiere que la temporalidad juega un papel importante en muchas de las ideas centrales de Jung, y está estrechamente interrelacionada con su enfoque general de la psique y el cosmos en general.

Jung propuso una verdad profunda: ese tiempo es relativo en general. Para apreciar toda nuestra experiencia debemos llegar más allá de la causalidad y la linealidad temporal, a desarrollar un enfoque que permita experiencias multidimensionales y sincronizadas. El entendimiento de Jung superó el enfoque dicotómico de Freud, que restringió la atemporalidad al inconsciente; su teoría del tiempo nos permite llegar más allá del mundo cotidiano de tiempo en un reino mayor, rico en significado y conexión.

Incluido en el libro:

- La teoría del tiempo de Jung

- la muerte del tiempo

- metáforas temporales y espaciales

- el papel del tiempo en precognición, telepatía y sincronización -Unus mundus y tiempo

- una comparación de las teorías temporales de Freud y Jung: la direccionalidad temporal, la dimensionalidad y el papel de la atemporalidad.

Este libro es el primero en explorar el tiempo y la atemporalidad de manera sistemática desde una perspectiva judia, y el primero en investigar cómo el concepto del tiempo afectó el desarrollo general de la teoría de Jung. Será una lectura clave para los estudiosos psicoanalíticos y los clínicos, así como para aquellos que trabajan en el campo de la filosofía fenomenológica.

title: Private Equity 4.0: Reinventing Value Creation
description:
"Private equity is more economically significant than ever, as institutions hunt for high returns in a risky world. Private Equity 4.0 examines the role, workings and contribution of this important industry in a straightforward yet revealing manner."

Dr. Josh Lerner

Jacob H. Schiff Professor of Investment Banking ?Chair, Entrepreneurial Management Unit

Harvard Business School

A multi-perspective look at private equity's inner workings

Private Equity 4.0 provides an insider perspective on the private equity industry, and analyzes the fundamental evolution of the private equity asset class over the past 30 years, from alternative to mainstream. The book provides insightful interviews of key industry figures, and case studies of some of the success stories in the industry. It also answers key questions related to strategy, fund manager selection, incentive mechanisms, performance comparison, red flags in prospectuses, and more.

Private Equity 4.0 offers guidance for the many stakeholders that could benefit from a more complete understanding of this special area of finance.

Understand the industry's dominant business models

Discover how value is created and performance measured

Perform a deep dive into the ecosystem of professionals that make the industry hum, including the different incentive systems that support the industry's players

Elaborate a clear set of guidelines to invest in the industry and deliver better performance

Written by a team of authors that combine academic and industry expertise to produce a well-rounded perspective, this book details the inner workings of private equity and gives readers the background they need to feel confident about committing to this asset class. Coverage includes a historical perspective on the business models of the three major waves of private equity leading to today's 4.0 model, a detailed analysis of the industry today, as well as reflections on the future of private equity and prospective futures. It also provides readers with the analytical and financial tools to analyze a fund's performance, with clear explanations of the mechanisms, organizations, and individuals that make the system work.

The authors demystify private equity by providing a balanced, but critical, review of its contributions and shortcomings and moving beyond the simplistic journalistic descriptions. Its ecosystem is complex and not recognizing that complexity leads to inappropriate judgments. Because of its assumed opacity and some historical deviant (and generally transient) practices, it has often been accused of evil intents, making it an ideal scapegoat in times of economic crisis, prodding leading politicians and regulators to intervene and demand changes in practices. Unfortunately, such actors were often responding to public calls for action rather than a thorough understanding of the factors at play in this complex interdependent system, doing often more harm than good in the process and depriving economies of one of their most dynamic and creative forces. Self-regulation has clearly shown its limits, but righteous political interventions even more so.

Private equity investment can be a valuable addition to many portfolios, but investors need a clear understanding of the forces at work before committing to this asset class. With detailed explanations and expert insights, Private Equity 4.0 is a comprehensive guide to the industry ways and means that enables the reader to capture its richness and sustainability.
translatedDescription:
"La equidad privada es más económicamente significativa que nunca, ya que las instituciones buscan altos rendimientos en un mundo arriesgado. La Equidad Privada 4.0 examina el papel, el trabajo y la contribución de esta importante industria de una manera sencilla pero reveladora."

Dr. Josh Lerner

Jacob H. Schiff Professor of Investment Banking ? Chair, Entrepreneurial Management Unit

Harvard Business School

Una mirada multi-perspectiva a los trabajos internos de la equidad privada

La Equidad Privada 4.0 ofrece una perspectiva interior en la industria de la equidad privada, y analiza la evolución fundamental de la clase de activos de capital privado en los últimos 30 años, desde alternativa a la corriente principal. El libro ofrece entrevistas perspicaces de figuras clave de la industria, y estudios de casos de algunos de los éxitos de la industria. También responde a preguntas clave relacionadas con la estrategia, la selección de gestores de fondos, los mecanismos de incentivos, la comparación del desempeño, las banderas rojas en los prospectos, y más.

Private Equity 4.0 ofrece orientación para los muchos interesados que podrían beneficiarse de una comprensión más completa de este área especial de finanzas.

Comprender los modelos de negocio dominantes de la industria

Descubra cómo se crea el valor y se mide el rendimiento

Realizar una profunda inmersión en el ecosistema de profesionales que hacen que la industria se humee, incluyendo los diferentes sistemas de incentivos que apoyan a los jugadores de la industria

Elaborar un conjunto claro de directrices para invertir en la industria y ofrecer mejores resultados

Escrito por un equipo de autores que combinan conocimientos académicos e industriales para producir una perspectiva bien redondeada, este libro detalla el funcionamiento interno de la equidad privada y da a los lectores el fondo que necesitan para sentirse confiados en comprometerse con esta clase de activos. La cobertura incluye una perspectiva histórica sobre los modelos de negocio de las tres principales olas de equidad privada que conducen al modelo actual 4.0, un análisis detallado de la industria hoy en día, así como reflexiones sobre el futuro de la equidad privada y futuros prospectivos. También proporciona a los lectores las herramientas analíticas y financieras para analizar el rendimiento de un fondo, con explicaciones claras de los mecanismos, organizaciones e individuos que hacen que el sistema funcione.

Los autores desmitifican la equidad privada proporcionando una revisión equilibrada, pero crítica, de sus contribuciones y deficiencias y yendo más allá de las descripciones periodísticas simplificadas. Su ecosistema es complejo y no reconoce que la complejidad conduce a juicios inapropiados. Debido a su opacidad asumida y a algunas prácticas desviadoras históricas (y generalmente transitorias), a menudo se le ha acusado de malas intenciones, convirtiéndolo en un chivo expiatorio ideal en tiempos de crisis económica, proponiendo a los políticos y reguladores líderes intervenir y exigir cambios en las prácticas. Lamentablemente, esos agentes a menudo estaban respondiendo a los llamamientos públicos para que se adoptaran medidas en lugar de comprender cabalmente los factores en juego en este complejo sistema interdependiente, haciendo a menudo más daño que bien en el proceso y privando a las economías de una de sus fuerzas más dinámicas y creativas. La autorregulación ha mostrado claramente sus límites, pero las intervenciones políticas justas aún más.

La inversión en capital privado puede ser una valiosa adición a muchas carteras, pero los inversores necesitan una comprensión clara de las fuerzas en el trabajo antes de comprometerse con esta clase de activos. Con explicaciones detalladas y perspicacias expertas, Private Equity 4.0 es una guía integral de los modos y medios de la industria que permite al lector captar su riqueza y sostenibilidad.

title: Investigating Cryptocurrencies
description:
Investigate crimes involving cryptocurrencies and other blockchain technologies

Bitcoin has traditionally been the payment system of choice for a criminal trading on the Dark Web, and now many other blockchain cryptocurrencies are entering the mainstream as traders are accepting them from low-end investors putting their money into the market. Worse still, the blockchain can even be used to hide information and covert messaging, unknown to most investigators.

Investigating Cryptocurrencies is the first book to help corporate, law enforcement, and other investigators understand the technical concepts and the techniques for investigating crimes utilizing the blockchain and related digital currencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum.

Understand blockchain and transaction technologies  
Set up and run cryptocurrency accounts
Build information about specific addresses
Access raw data on blockchain ledgers
Identify users of cryptocurrencies
Extracting cryptocurrency data from live and imaged computers
Following the money

With nearly $150 billion in cryptocurrency circulating and $3 billion changing hands daily, crimes committed with or paid for with digital cash are a serious business. Luckily, Investigating Cryptocurrencies Forensics shows you how to detect it and, more importantly, stop it in its tracks.
translatedDescription:
Investigar los delitos relacionados con las criptomonedas y otras tecnologías de bloqueo

Bitcoin ha sido tradicionalmente el sistema de pago de elección para un comercio criminal en la Web Oscura, y ahora muchas otras criptomonedas de blockchain están entrando en la corriente principal, ya que los comerciantes los están aceptando de inversores de gama baja poniendo su dinero en el mercado. Peor aún, la cadena de bloqueo puede incluso ser utilizada para ocultar información y mensajería encubierta, desconocido para la mayoría de los investigadores.

Investigar Cryptocurrencies es el primer libro para ayudar a las empresas, las fuerzas del orden y otros investigadores a entender los conceptos técnicos y las técnicas para investigar los delitos utilizando la cadena de bloques y las monedas digitales relacionadas como Bitcoin y Ethereum.
